questions.prompt: Which country produced the philosopher Confucius?
questions.fact: He held only minor office in life, and his teachings became state doctrine centuries after his death.

questions.prompt: What is the term for a wave's height from rest to peak?
questions.fact: For sound it corresponds to loudness, while frequency corresponds to pitch.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a shot called the smash?
questions.fact: In each it means the same thing: hitting downward from above the net with maximum power.

questions.prompt: Which film features a character called Truman Burbank?
questions.fact: A psychiatric delusion in which people believe they are being filmed is now sometimes named after it.

questions.prompt: Which lake forms part of the border between the US and Canada?
questions.fact: Lake Michigan is the only Great Lake entirely within the United States.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Beloved's Nobel-winning author's debut, The Bluest Eye?
questions.fact: It sold poorly at first and has since become one of the most frequently challenged books in America.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Blender 3D software?
questions.fact: It was bought out of a failing company by a community fundraiser and released as open source in 2002.
